item.title: Canvas Drawing Libraries in 2026: Konva vs Fabric.js vs Paper.js — Which One Should You Actually Use?
item.description: Whiteboard apps, diagram editors, image annotation tools, floor planners — every one of them starts with the same painful decision: which HTML5 Canvas library do you build on? Pick wrong and you will re-architect your rendering layer six months in, when selection, hit-testing, and undo suddenly become impossible to bolt on. The three serious contenders are Konva (14,709 stars), Fabric.js (31,403 stars), and Paper.js (15,065 stars), and they are not interchangeable: each one encodes a different mental model of what a canvas app is.
